_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest for the #1525 process-tree kill proof. Read by apps/front/scripts/ci/run-preuves.mts BEFORE classification. Each test declared in `expectedRed` MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code. If a declared kept-red test PASSES, the runner fails CI with verdict CORRUPT PROOF. The runner refuses to classify if this file is missing, invalid JSON, or the test list is empty.

expectedRed.testName: kills a frozen process tree and leaves no orphaned descendants
expectedRed.why: On correct code, `detached: true` makes the child a process-group leader. `kill(-child.pid)` kills the entire tree; survivors = 0, so `expect(survivors).toBeGreaterThan(0)` FAILS with an AssertionError. If this test passes, `detached: true` is absent or `kill(-child.pid)` is replaced with `kill(child.pid)` — the orphaned descendant survives and the #1525 bug is restored.

expectedRed.testName: prints the guard path and timeout duration on timeout
expectedRed.why: On correct code, the wrapper prints 'GUARD TIMEOUT: <path> did not finish within 3s'. The assertion `expect(result.stderr).toContain(guardPath)` fails because the error message format was stripped (replaced with bare `console.error` or removed). If this test passes, the clear error message was restored — the #1525 requirement is met.
